newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Some 80 pct EDP revenue to amortise debt.
newsitem.headline: Some 80 pct EDP revenue to amortise debt.

text.p: Some 80 percent of the revenues from the partial privatisation next month of state electricity company EDP-Electricidade de Portugal will be used to amortise public debt, Under-Secretary for Finance said.
"About 80 percent (of revenues) will be used to amortise public debt, while the rest will be used to finance public companies," he told reporters.
Portugal on Thursday set a price of 1,750-2,250 escudos ($1.02-1.32) per share for the partial privatisation of EDP, the biggest state sale yet carried out in the country.
The privatisation should raise up to 400 billion escudos, if the state floats between 20 and 30 percent of the company, although the exact percentage to be sold will be set early next month.
